  3. <fidel-question>

<fidel-question>

Ask about this moment. A button under the player that opens a dialog to ask about the current moment in writing, by voice note or in sign language.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Deaf learners (ask in sign language), blind learners and learners who find writing hard (a voice note), and shy learners: no name is needed.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። This example has no api, so the question goes to the page and nothing is uploaded.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-player id="lesson-player" lesson="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/api/v1/lessons/LESSON_ID"></fidel-player>
<fidel-question for="lesson-player" api="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/api/v1"></fidel-question>

Source: player/src/components/e/question.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-question>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
forid of a <fidel-player>the first <fidel-player> on the pageThe player this component works with.
apiURLnoneThe Fidel API (e.g. /api/v1). Without it, the page receives the question as an event.
lessonidfrom the player's lesson URLLesson id for the server.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-question>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-question-ready{ time, kind, text | blob, mimeType }Without api: the question for the page to handle.
fidel-question-sent{ lessonId, time, kind }With api: the question reached the server.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • The dialog holds the video time (an editable minutes:seconds field) and the caption shown then.
  • Write, Voice note or Sign language are radio buttons, not tabs.
  • The video pauses while the dialog is open. Escape or Cancel closes it and returns focus to the button.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.1.1 Keyboard: Every control is native; Escape closes the dialog.
  • 3.3.1 Error Identification: Wrong time, an empty question and "Record your question first" are in words.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: Sent, saved offline and sent later are announced.
  • Offline: the question is kept on the phone (recordings up to about 2 MB) and sent when the phone is online again.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
